tc_name: Customer Deposit, Withdrawal, and Transaction Verification (Positive Flow)
tc_description:
Test Case Title: Customer Deposit, Withdrawal, and Transaction Verification (Positive Flow)
Module: Customer Banking Operations
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- - The banking web application is accessible.
- - 'Ron Weasley' is an existing customer in the system.

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the banking application's home page.
2. Wait until the Customer Login button is visible.
3. Click the Customer Login button.
4. Select "Ron Weasley" from the customer dropdown menu.
5. Click the Login button.
6. Wait for the Account Dashboard to load.
7. Click the Deposit button.
8. Enter the amount: 123456.
9. Click the Deposit button.
10. Verify that a success message is displayed and the account balance increases.
11. Click the Withdrawal button.
12. Enter the amount: 23456.
13. Click the Withdrawal button.
14. Verify that a success message is displayed and the account balance decreases.
15. Click the Transactions button.
16. Review the transaction history to confirm records of the deposit and withdrawal.
17. Click the Back button to return to the dashboard.
18. Click the Logout button.
19. Verify redirection to the Customer Login page.

Expected Result:
- - The Customer Login page loads and allows account selection.
- - Ron Weasley is logged in and the Account Dashboard displays relevant account details.
- - Deposit of 123456 completes, increasing the balance and showing a success message.
- - Withdrawal of 23456 completes, decreasing the balance and showing a success message.
- - Transaction history accurately displays both the deposit and withdrawal.
- - The user is returned to the dashboard and can successfully log out, returning to the Customer Login.

Wait until the Customer Login button is visible.
Click the Customer Login button.

Enter the amount: 123456.
Click the Deposit button.

Verify that a success message is displayed and the account balance decreases.
Click the Transactions button.
Review the transaction history to confirm records of the deposit and withdrawal.
Click the Back button to return to the dashboard.
Click the Logout button.
Verify redirection to the Customer Login page.

Module: Goodweather Theme Settings and Navigation
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- - User is logged into the Goodweather application
- - Application is loaded on a compatible device

Test Steps:
1. Wait for 2 seconds after launching the app.
2. Click on the Refresh icon.

Expected Result:

Preconditions:

11. Tap the ADD TO CART button.
12. Wait for the Remove button to be visible.
13. Tap the BACK TO PRODUCTS button.

18. Wait for the PRODUCTS title to be visible.

21. Tap the ADD TO CART button.

- - Product detail pages display correctly, and items can be added to the cart.
- - Cart displays all added items accurately.
- - Checkout flow accepts user input for all mandatory fields.
